split: # HOW TO FILL THIS IN. Read before adding a row; a bad row silently corrupts
# the only number you are going to put on a slide.
# Each row is a CLOSED issue that (a) contains a screenshot and (b) is linked
# to a MERGED pull request that fixed it.
#   split        tune | test
#                First 3 rows = tune. Everything else = test.
#                You may look at tune as often as you like. Look at test ONCE
#                at the end. Numbers from tune are NOT results.
#   issue_url    https://github.com/owner/repo/issues/123
#   repo_path    local clone of that repo
#                Use a separate clone per row if the commits differ.
#   base_commit  the fix PR's BASE commit (the commit the PR branched from).
#                  gh pr view <PR> --repo owner/repo --json baseRefOid
#                Then: git -C <repo_path> checkout <base_commit>
#                NEVER evaluate at HEAD: the fix is already there and the
#                result is meaningless. `eval --check` compares the repo's
#                HEAD against this field and refuses to run on a mismatch.
#   gold_files   ';'-separated repo-relative paths the fix PR CHANGED
#                EXCLUDING tests
#                  gh pr diff <PR> --repo owner/repo --name-only
#                If after exclusions nothing is left
#                drop it rather than padding gold_files with a test file.
#   notes        anything you want; ignored by the harness.
# VALIDATE BEFORE SPENDING API CALLS:
#   python3 -m snaplocate.cli eval data/issues.csv --check
# THEN
